summary.text: Sara Eggler is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a real estate professional who said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running on a non-partisan focus on local issues.

paragraphs.text: Sara Eggler earned a bachelor's degree from Lycoming College in 2006.
She said in a Ballotpedia survey that she grew up in the district, that her family roots there run deep, and that she has built a real estate business over the past seven years.
Eggler said she has been registered as a Republican and as an Independent in the past.

Eggler listed three key messages: securing funding for first responders, roads, schools, hospitals and other services; reducing fuel taxes and raising livable wages; and expanding rural healthcare access.
She also named housing access and affordability as an issue she is passionate about.
